create_Stat_class: create a Stat object to track running mean and std of torch tensor values
update_Stat_with_tensor: update a Stat object with new torch tensor data to accumulate statistics
create_F0Stat_class: create an F0Stat object to track F0 statistics filtering out unvoiced zero frames
create_Accuracy_class: create an Accuracy object to track prediction accuracy with a tolerance threshold
compute_Accuracy_score: compute the accuracy score from an Accuracy object using a tolerance value
